modes.label: Tooth naming
modes.description: Linking words or word starts in descriptions of tooth types, right before names like incisors or premolars.
modes.example: Your front teeth are<< called>> incisors.

modes.label: Upper gum placement
modes.description: The word upper or maxillary in dental or buccal tablet placement instructions.
